name: Social Micro-Breaks
description: Light, optional ideas for a friendly moment with someone nearby, with no pressure.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Optional ideas for a friendly moment, shown on Away Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. These are invitations, never tasks.
howToPlay: Step away and read the idea.
Press Another idea if it does not feel right today.
Press Back at desk when you return.
tips: Only if you feel like it. Quiet time is just as good. Ideas are only suggestions.
